title: For each non-deleted instance that has system metadata key equal to 'image_
question: For each non-deleted instance that has system metadata key equal to 'image_image_type', show the instance ID, UUID, user ID, project ID, display name, VM state, memory (MB), vCPUs, instance info cache record ID, the maximum instance ID over the current row and the next 2 rows when ordered by instance ID, plus the instance availability zone, the number of system metadata entries, and the total vCPUs. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH eligible_instances AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT i.uuid
  FROM instances i
  JOIN instance_system_metadata sm
    ON sm.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  WHERE i.deleted = 0
    AND sm.`key` = 'image_image_type'
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    i.id AS instance_id,
    i.uuid AS instance_uuid,
    i.user_id,
    i.project_id,
    i.display_name,
    i.vm_state,
    i.memory_mb,
    i.vcpus,
    iic.id AS instance_info_cache_id,
    i.availability_zone
  FROM instances i
  JOIN eligible_instances e ON e.uuid = i.uuid
  LEFT JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid
),
windowed AS (
  SELECT
    b.instance_id,
    b.instance_uuid,
    b.user_id,
    b.project_id,
    b.display_name,
    b.vm_state,
    b.memory_mb,
    b.vcpus,
    b.instance_info_cache_id,
    b.availability_zone,
    MAX(b.instance_id) OVER (ORDER BY b.instance_id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_id_next2
  FROM base b
),
metadata_counts AS (
  SELECT
    ism.instance_uuid,
    COUNT(ism.id) AS sys_metadata_count
  FROM instance_system_metadata ism
  JOIN eligible_instances e ON e.uuid = ism.instance_uuid
  GROUP BY ism.instance_uuid
),
total_vcpus AS (
  SELECT SUM(b.vcpus) AS total_vcpus
  FROM base b
)
SELECT
  w.instance_id,
  w.instance_uuid,
  w.user_id,
  w.project_id,
  w.display_name,
  w.vm_state,
  w.memory_mb,
  w.vcpus,
  w.instance_info_cache_id,
  w.max_id_next2,
  w.availability_zone,
  mc.sys_metadata_count,
  tv.total_vcpus
FROM windowed w
JOIN metadata_counts mc ON mc.instance_uuid = w.instance_uuid
CROSS JOIN total_vcpus tv
ORDER BY w.instance_id;

WITH eligible_instances AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT i.uuid
  FROM instances i
  JOIN instance_system_metadata sm
    ON sm.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  WHERE i.deleted = 0
    AND sm.`key` = 'image_image_type'
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    i.id AS instance_id,
    i.uuid AS instance_uuid,
    i.user_id,
    i.project_id,
    i.display_name,
    i.vm_state,
    i.memory_mb,
    i.vcpus,
    iic.id AS instance_info_cache_id,
    i.availability_zone
  FROM instances i
  JOIN eligible_instances e ON e.uuid = i.uuid
  LEFT JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid
),
windowed AS (
  SELECT
    b.instance_id,
    b.instance_uuid,
    b.user_id,
    b.project_id,
    b.display_name,
    b.vm_state,
    b.memory_mb,
    b.vcpus,
    b.instance_info_cache_id,
    b.availability_zone,
    MAX(b.instance_id) OVER (ORDER BY b.instance_id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_id_next2
  FROM base b
),
metadata_counts AS (
  SELECT
    ism.instance_uuid,
    COUNT(ism.id) AS sys_metadata_count
  FROM instance_system_metadata ism
  JOIN eligible_instances e ON e.uuid = ism.instance_uuid
  GROUP BY ism.instance_uuid
),
total_vcpus AS (
  SELECT SUM(b.vcpus) AS total_vcpus
  FROM base b
)
SELECT
  w.instance_id,
  w.instance_uuid,
  w.user_id,
  w.project_id,
  w.display_name,
  w.vm_state,
  w.memory_mb,
  w.vcpus,
  w.instance_info_cache_id,
  w.max_id_next2,
  w.availability_zone,
  mc.sys_metadata_count,
  tv.total_vcpus
FROM windowed w
JOIN metadata_counts mc ON mc.instance_uuid = w.instance_uuid
CROSS JOIN total_vcpus tv
ORDER BY w.instance_id;
